scraped.scraped_description: Discover how the Cambridge Online Trust & Safety Index (COTSI) tracks SMS verifications of social media accounts, such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, and Telegram; cloud infrastructure providers, such as Amazon Web Services, Google Firebase, and OpenAI; marketplaces; online banks; crypto exchanges; and more.

name: COTSI (Cyber Operational Threat Situational Intelligence)
tagline: Tracks daily price and availability of fake SMS verifications across 197 countries and 500+ platforms to map the online manipulation economy
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
political_relevance_summary: Addresses threats to digital autonomy and privacy rights that affect civic participation and civil liberties.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides evidence and data that amplifies advocacy and accountability efforts.

generalizability_notes: Already deployed across multiple jurisdictions (multiple countries), demonstrating cross-context adaptability. Methodology and approach could inform similar efforts in other jurisdictions.
